content: João Moutinho, Director of BUILT CoLAB, attended the EDIH Summit 2024 which took place in Brussels on 26 and 27 November, representing the DIGITALbuilt consortium, the European Digital Innovation Hub of which BUILT CoLAB is a member. These two days were conducive to sharing knowledge and information about the development of European Digital Innovation Hubs, to working together and to various networking opportunities. João Moutinho took part in the working sessions of the Construction Workgroup, which produced recommendations for changes to the Joint Research Centre (JRC) and the Digital Transformation Accelerator (DTA), for improvements to be made to the Digital Maturity Assessment Tool (DMAT). It was also an excellent opportunity to discuss some important aspects of the implementation of DIGITALbuilt with the Project Officer.
